# RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Complete `.rsip`, `.rsis` & `.rsii` Reference (v0.9.1)

Generated deterministically by `RaggieSoft Installer Studio (instbuild.exe 0.9.1) --emit-ai-spec`.

## 1. Architectural Rules & AI Pre-Flight Checklist
1. **Native MSI, MSM, MST, MSP & LZMS SetupWizard.exe Output**: Calls `msiquery.h` (`msi.lib`), `fci.h`/`fdi.h`, and `COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_LZMS` (`Cabinet.lib`) directly from static `/MT` C++20.
2. **100% White-Label Attribution (`Community == Architect`)**: Visible dialogs and `Setup.exe` `VERSIONINFO` use `[Package] Manufacturer` and `Name` exclusively; `RaggieSoft Installer Studio (instbuild.exe 0.9.1)` is recorded solely in MSI `SummaryInformation` `PID_APPNAME`.
3. **3-Part MSI Version Rule**: `[Package] Version` MUST use 3-part `Major.Minor.Build` format (`0..255.0..255.0..65535`, e.g., `1.2.0` — never a 4-part `1.2.0.0` string).
4. **Uppercase Braced `UpgradeCode` GUID**: `[Package] UpgradeCode` MUST be a permanent `{XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX}` GUID kept identical across all releases of the same product.
5. **Mandatory `&` Keyboard Mnemonics**: Custom interactive labels (`[UI] InstallButtonText = &Install`, `FinishLaunchCheckbox = &Launch app`) MUST include `&` for WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard access.
6. **Microsoft Component Rules (`RSW031` & `RSW032`)**: Every `[Payload.*]` assigned to an explicit `[Component.<Id>]` must share one destination directory (`RSW031`), and components targeting per-user folders (`AppDataFolder`, `LocalAppDataFolder`, `StartMenu`, `Desktop`) must use `KeyPathKind = registry` (`HKCU`, `RSW032`).
7. **Pre-MSI `[Prerequisite.<Id>]` Execution**: Runtimes (`DotNet11Desktop`, `DotNet11AspNet`, `DotNet11Runtime`, `DotNet10Desktop`, `DotNet10AspNet`, `DotNet10Runtime`, `DotNet9Desktop`, `DotNet8Desktop`, `EdgeWebView2`, `VcRedist2022`, or `Custom`) execute BEFORE `msiexec` under a single UAC prompt (`download`, `embedded` LZMS, or `side-by-side` `Redist\`) and latch `RebootExitCodes` (`3010, 1641, 23`).
8. **64-Bit Silicon & `PID_TEMPLATE` Rules (`x64;1033` vs `Arm64;1033` — Zero `IA-64` / `x86` Host Builds)**: Host toolchain & outer Universal `Setup.exe` stubs are strictly 64-bit (`IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64` `0x8664` outer stub using `IsWow64Process2` to pierce Windows 11 Prism and dispatch native `ARM64` `0xAA64` vs `x64` `0x8664`). MSI `SummaryInformation` `PID_TEMPLATE` MUST strictly use `x64;1033` (AMD64/Intel 64-bit) or `Arm64;1033` (64-bit ARM)—NEVER `Intel64;1033` (deceased IA-64 Itanium!).
9. **Multi-Engine Packaging (`v0.9` `PackageKind = msi|msm|sfx|addon|suite`, `Engine = msi|raggiescript`, `RsPatch.exe` & `RsUpdate.exe`)**: Build enterprise `.msi` databases (including `[Upgrade]` Major/Minor/Small servicing, `[Media]` multi-volume `CAB1.cab..CABN.cab` spanning, `Compression = none` loose source media, `msiexec /a` administrative installs, and `.rswpak` `Delivery = ondemand` feature packs), lightweight self-extracting archives (`PackageKind = sfx` with selectable UAC `RequestedExecutionLevel`), **Host-Aware Add-On / Content Pack Installers (`PackageKind = addon` + `[HostApp]`)** unlocked in ALL 4 Editions for books/albums/plugins, zero-MSI **RaggieScript EXE** (`Engine = raggiescript`) direct transactional setups with retired-file pruning & `RsPatch.exe` `msdelta.dll` `.rswpatch` deltas, `RsUpdate.exe` DRY `apps-manifest.json` client updates, or **Unified Suite & Web Workload Setups (`PackageKind = suite`, `Delivery = embedded|side-by-side|web`, `SuiteRollbackPolicy = rollback_new`, `RollbackBoundary`, & dynamic `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT` adoption)**.
10. **Lossless AST Comments**: `;` and `#` comments plus `@include` directives survive `InstallerStudio.exe` GUI edits byte-for-byte.

## 2. Complete `.rsip` Project Schema (`v0.9`)

### `[Package]` (*Required*)
Core product identity, PackageKind (msi/msm/sfx/addon/suite), Engine (msi/raggiescript), UAC execution level, SuiteRollbackPolicy, target CPU architecture (x64/arm64), and universal output settings.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `SchemaVersion` | `string` | No | `0.9` | Manifest grammar version (`0.9`). |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Consumer-facing ProductName written to MSI Property table and VERSIONINFO. |
| `Version` | `msi_version (Major.Minor.Build)` | **Yes** | — | Three-part Windows Installer version (`Major.Minor.Build`, max `255.255.65535`). |
| `Manufacturer` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Publisher name written to MSI `Manufacturer` property and VERSIONINFO `CompanyName`. |
| `UpgradeCode` | `guid ({XXXXXXXX-...})` | **Yes** | — | Permanent `{GUID}` shared across all releases of this product for Major Upgrades and UUIDv5 seeding. |
| `ProductCode` | `guid_or_auto ('*' or {GUID})` | No | `*` | `*` generates a fresh ProductCode GUID on each build, or specify an explicit `{GUID}`. |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Summary Information description and Setup.exe `FileDescription`. |
| `Language` | `integer` | No | `1033` | Numeric Windows LCID (`1033` = English - United States). |
| `Architecture` | `enum` | No | `arm64` | Allowed: `x64|arm64`. Target silicon (`x64` -> `x64;1033`, `arm64` -> `Arm64;1033`). Overridable via `--arch=<x64|arm64>`. |
| `Scope` | `enum` | No | `machine` | Allowed: `machine|user`. `machine` (`ALLUSERS=1`, `ProgramFiles64Folder`) or `user` (per-user `LocalAppDataFolder`, zero UAC). |
| `OutputName` | `string` | No | — | Base filename stem (supports `$(ARCH)`); defaults to `<kebab-name>-$(ARCH)`. |
| `OutputDir` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | `out` | Output folder for `<OutputName>.msi` and `<OutputName>-setup.exe` (relative to `.rsip` folder or absolute). |
| `BuildBootstrapper` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true`, emits branded `<OutputName>-setup.exe` embedding `Product.msi` alongside the standalone `.msi`. |
| `CabinetCompression` | `enum` | No | `lzx` | Allowed: `lzx|mszip`. Compression algorithm for embedded `#payload.cab` (`lzx` = high-ratio LZX:21, `mszip` = fast DEFLATE). |
| `HideFromInstalledApps` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT=1` so content micro-installers do not clutter Windows Installed Apps. |
| `AboutUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional support/product website URL written to `ARPURLINFOABOUT`. |
| `PackageKind` | `enum` | No | `msi` | Allowed: `msi|msm|sfx|addon|suite`. `msi` builds an Enterprise `.msi` (+ optional `-setup.exe`), `msm` builds a Merge Module (`.msm`), `sfx` builds a lightweight LZMS Self-Extracting `.exe`, `addon` builds a Host-Aware Add-On / Content Pack Installer (`[HostApp]` locates the parent app and drops books/albums/plugins directly into its library directory), and `suite` builds a single-UAC Unified Suite / Web Workload Chainer. |
| `SuiteRollbackPolicy` | `enum` | No | `rollback_new` | Allowed: `keep_completed|rollback_new`. Controls failure & cancel recovery in `PackageKind = suite`: `rollback_new` (default) automatically uninstalls packages newly added in the current Suite session (up to the last `RollbackBoundary = true` savepoint on unexpected error, or 100% of session additions when the user confirms Cancel); `keep_completed` leaves already-finished member packages installed for fast resume. |
| `Engine` | `enum` | No | `msi` | Allowed: `msi|raggiescript|native`. `msi` uses Microsoft Windows Installer (`msi.dll`); `raggiescript` (alias `native`) builds a **RaggieScript EXE** zero-`msi.dll` transactional LZMS installer with rollback journal, `.lnk` shortcuts, `Uninstall` registry registration, and signed `Uninstall.exe`. |
| `RequestedExecutionLevel` | `enum` | No | `asInvoker` | Allowed: `asInvoker|highestAvailable|requireAdministrator`. Controls Windows UAC level stamped onto PE `RT_MANIFEST` `#1` across `msi`, `native`, `sfx`, and `suite` EXEs: `asInvoker` (default — un-elevated launch; prompts UAC only if per-machine install begins), `highestAvailable` (elevates upfront for Admins while letting Standard Users run), or `requireAdministrator` (requires Admin UAC immediately at `0.0s` launch). |
| `BuildUniversal` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true` (or when `--universal` is passed to `instbuild.exe`), compiles both `x64` and `arm64` editions and emits `<UniversalOutputName>-offline-setup.exe` plus `<UniversalOutputName>-setup.exe`. |
| `UniversalOutputName` | `string` | No | — | Optional base filename stem for universal combined installers; defaults to `OutputName` stripped of `-$(ARCH)`. |
| `UniversalDownloadBaseUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional HTTPS folder URL hosting `<OutputName>-x64-setup.exe`, `<OutputName>-arm64-setup.exe`, and `.rswpak` feature packs. |
| `Tagline` | `string` | No | — | Short subtitle displayed beneath the product title in `SetupWizard.exe` and `InstallerStudio.exe`. |
| `WebsiteLabel` | `string` | No | — | Optional domain badge shown in the setup wizard footer (left blank if omitted — 100% white-label!). |

### `[HostApp]` (*Optional*)
Host application discovery & automatic content placement rules ([HostApp]) for PackageKind = addon (locates an installed Host App such as Book Reader or Listening Room via UpgradeCode/Registry/Executable and places books, albums, plugins, or DLC into the right directory with zero full-installer ceremony).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Display name of the required parent application (e.g. `RaggieSoft Book Reader` or `The Listening Room`). |
| `UpgradeCode` | `guid ({XXXXXXXX-...})` | No | — | Optional `{UpgradeCode}` of the host application probed via MSI `MsiEnumRelatedProductsW` and Windows `Uninstall` Registry. |
| `RegistryHive` | `enum` | No | `auto` | Allowed: `auto|HKCU|HKLM`. Registry hive searched for `RegistryKey` (`auto` probes `HKCU` first, then 64-bit `HKLM`). |
| `RegistryKey` | `string` | No | — | Optional registry key holding the host install directory (e.g. `Software\RaggieSoft\Book Reader`). |
| `RegistryValue` | `string` | No | `Install Path` | Registry value name under `RegistryKey` holding the host install folder (also falls back to `InstallLocation` and `InstallDir`). |
| `FallbackSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional fallback folder relative to `%ProgramFiles%` or `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (e.g. `RaggieSoft\Book Reader`) checked if Registry/MSI keys are absent. |
| `Executable` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional executable relative to the detected host folder (e.g. `BookReader.exe`) verified on disk to confirm the host is genuinely installed. |
| `ContentTargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `LocalAppData` | Allowed: `HostInstallDir|LocalAppData|CommonAppData|AppData`. Where to place the add-on content once the host is verified: `HostInstallDir` (`<DetectedHostDir>\<ContentSubdir>` for plugins/mods/help packs), `LocalAppData` (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\<ContentSubdir>` for zero-UAC per-user books & albums), `CommonAppData` (`%ProgramData%`), or `AppData` (`%APPDATA%`). |
| `ContentSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Destination subfolder under `ContentTargetRoot` (e.g. `RaggieSoft\Books\cedar-run` or `Plugins\SynthPack`; defaults to `[Install] DefaultSubdir`). |
| `DownloadUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional HTTPS URL opened when the user clicks `&Get Host...` if the required host application is not yet installed. |
| `LaunchUri` | `string` | No | — | Optional URI or host CLI argument launched when the user leaves `&Open in <HostName>` checked on completion (e.g. `raggiesoft-books://cedar-run`). |
| `RefreshArgs` | `string` | No | — | Optional CLI switch passed silently to `Executable` if the host app is already running during add-on installation (e.g. `--refresh-library`). |
| `RequireHostInstalled` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), verifies the host application is installed before unpacking content (returning `1605` in `/s` silent mode or offering `DownloadUrl` interactively if missing). |

### `[Requirements]` (*Optional*)
Minimum Windows 11 build gate (RtlGetVersion & MSI LaunchCondition), downgrade protection, and silent reboot exit code.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `MinWindowsBuild` | `integer` | No | `22000` | Minimum Windows 10/11 build number (`22000` = Windows 11 21H2+, matching .NET 10 Desktop Runtime). |
| `OsLaunchMessage` | `string` | No | `This application requires Windows 11 (Build 22000) or later.` | Friendly message shown by LaunchCondition / SetupWizard.exe when the host OS is older than MinWindowsBuild. |
| `BlockDowngrades` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Adds a newer-version Upgrade row + LaunchCondition preventing accidental downgrades. |
| `SilentRebootExitCode` | `integer` | No | `3010` | Process exit code returned in silent mode (`/s` / `/qn`) when a runtime prerequisite or MSI requests a Windows restart (`3010` standard MSI). |

### `[Upgrade]` (*Optional*)
Declarative update & servicing policy ([Upgrade]): Strategy (major|minor|small_hotfix), RemoveExistingProducts Schedule (early 1525 vs late 6550), MigrateFeatures (257), BaselineMsi, and RsUpdate.exe UpdateFeedUrl.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Strategy` | `enum` | No | `major` | Allowed: `major|minor|small_hotfix`. `major` (default, all editions) mints a fresh `ProductCode` per version and runs `RemoveExistingProducts`; `minor` (Architect/Community) preserves `BaselineMsi`'s `ProductCode` for `.MSP` / `REINSTALLMODE=vomus` Minor Upgrades; `small_hotfix` (Architect/Community) preserves both `ProductCode` and `Version` for emergency hotfix `.MSP` patches. |
| `Schedule` | `enum` | No | `early` | Allowed: `early|late`. Controls when `RemoveExistingProducts` executes in `InstallExecuteSequence`: `early` (`Sequence = 1525`, right after `InstallInitialize` — cleanest default) or `late` (`Sequence = 6550`, right before `InstallFinalize` — atomic in-place overwrite). |
| `MigrateFeatures` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), sets `msidbUpgradeAttributesMigrateFeatures` (`0x001` -> `Attributes = 257`) so `MigrateFeatureStates` preserves custom feature selections across Major Upgrades. |
| `AllowSameVersion` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, sets `msidbUpgradeAttributesVersionMaxInclusive` (`0x200`) on the `Upgrade` table row so rebuilt packages with the same 3-part `Version` and a new `ProductCode` upgrade cleanly. |
| `BaselineMsi` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional path to the baseline `.msi` (supports `$(ARCH)`) used to inherit `ProductCode` and verify Microsoft Component Rules (`RSW081`–`RSW086`) when `Strategy = minor` or `small_hotfix`. |
| `UpdateFeedUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional HTTPS URL to a `RaggieSoft Launcher`-compatible `apps-manifest.json` feed written to `<InstallDir>\UpdateConfig.json` for `RsUpdate.exe`. |
| `UpdateChannel` | `enum` | No | `stable` | Allowed: `stable|preview`. Release channel tag written to `UpdateConfig.json` (`stable` or `preview`). |

### `[Install]` (*Required*)
Default installation subfolder under ProgramFiles64Folder/LocalAppDataFolder and Start Menu group (optional when PackageKind = sfx or suite).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `DefaultSubdir` | `relpath` | **Yes** | — | Default target folder path under `ProgramFiles64Folder` (or `LocalAppDataFolder`), e.g. `MyCompany\MyApp`. |
| `StartMenuFolder` | `relpath` | No | — | Program Menu subfolder name created when `[Shortcut.*]` targets `StartMenu` (defaults to `[Package] Manufacturer`). |
| `MainExecutable` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional primary `.exe` relative to `INSTALLDIR` (used for `ARPPRODUCTICON` default & Finish launch). |

### `[Media]` (*Optional*)
Multi-volume cabinet disk spanning (MaxCabinetSizeMB -> CAB1.cab..CABN.cab), external vs. embedded cabinets, and uncompressed loose source media (Compression = none | cab).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Compression` | `enum` | No | `cab` | Allowed: `cab|none`. `cab` compresses payloads into `#payload.cab` or external `CAB1.cab..CABN.cab`; `none` emits uncompressed loose source files (`PID_WORDCOUNT` bit `1` cleared + `msidbFileAttributesNoncompressed` `0x2000`) for Run-from-Media / Network shares. |
| `EmbedCabinet` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` and `MaxCabinetSizeMB = 0` (`MaxCabinetSizeKB = 0`), embeds `#payload.cab` inside `Product.msi`; when `false` or spanning is active, emits external `CAB1.cab..CABN.cab` next to `Product.msi`. |
| `MaxCabinetSizeMB` | `integer` | No | `0` | Maximum size in megabytes (`1..2047`) per external cabinet (`CAB1.cab..CABN.cab`) before spanning to the next `DiskId` in the `Media` SQL table (`0` = undivided single cabinet). |
| `MaxCabinetSizeKB` | `integer` | No | `0` | Optional fine-grained maximum cabinet size in kilobytes (`>= 32`) before spanning to `CAB2.cab..CABN.cab` (overrides `MaxCabinetSizeMB` when `> 0`). |
| `VolumeLabel` | `string` | No | `DISK` | Volume label prefix written to `Media.VolumeLabel` (`DISK1`, `DISK2`, ...). |
| `DiskPrompt` | `string` | No | `Please insert [ProductName] Disk [1]` | Change-media prompt written to `Media.DiskPrompt` and `Property.DiskPrompt` (`Error 1302`). |

### `[SFX]` (*Optional*)
Lightweight LZMS self-extracting archive (.exe) post-extraction launch (PostExtractRun), document open (PostExtractOpen), temp staging, and folder options (PackageKind = sfx).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `DefaultExtractSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional default subfolder name created next to the self-extracting `.exe` when `ExtractToTemp = false`. |
| `PostExtractRun` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional bundled `.exe` or `.cmd` (relative to the extraction folder) launched automatically after extraction completes. |
| `PostExtractArgs` | `string` | No | — | Optional command-line arguments passed when launching `PostExtractRun`. |
| `PostExtractOpen` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional bundled document (`.pdf`, `.html`, `.txt`, `.rtf`, etc. relative to extraction folder) opened via `ShellExecuteExW` when a compatible viewer is installed. |
| `ExtractToTemp` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, defaults extraction to an isolated `%TEMP%\<Slug>-<PID>` temporary directory instead of prompting for a permanent folder. |
| `AllowChangeFolder` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), allows the user to edit or browse the destination folder before clicking `&Extract`. |
| `SilentOverwrite` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true`, overwrites existing files in the destination folder without extra prompts. |
| `CleanupTempAfterRun` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Software Installation Self-Extractor mode: when `true` (requires `ExtractToTemp = true` and `PostExtractRun`), waits for the launched setup program and any `WaitForProcess` / child processes to finish, then automatically deletes the temporary `%TEMP%` staging directory. |
| `WaitMode` | `enum` | No | `auto` | Allowed: `auto|none|direct|job_tree|process_name`. Controls how `[SFX]` waits for `PostExtractRun` before `%TEMP%` cleanup: `auto` (`job_tree` when `CleanupTempAfterRun = true`, else `none`), `none` (fire-and-forget), `direct` (wait only on initial process), `job_tree` (Win32 Job Object + any active process inside `%TEMP%` + `WaitForProcess`), or `process_name` (wait until all processes matching `WaitForProcess` exit). |
| `WaitForProcess` | `string` | No | — | Optional companion/cleanup executable name, wildcard, or semicolon/comma-separated list to wait for before deleting `%TEMP%` staging files (e.g., `_ISDEL.EXE; _INS*._MP; setup-worker.exe`). |
| `WaitSpawnGraceMs` | `integer` | No | `1500` | Milliseconds (`0..60000`) after `PostExtractRun` exits during which the self-extractor keeps watching for delayed handoff processes (`WaitForProcess` or `%TEMP%` executables like `_ISDEL.EXE`) before removing temporary files. |
| `AutoStartExtract` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, starts unpacking to `%TEMP%` and launching `PostExtractRun` immediately on startup without requiring an extra click on `&Extract`. |

### `[UI]` (*Optional*)
Branding, RTF license, icon, 11 selectable C++ WizardLayout styles (including 'simple' ultra-compact single-dialog mode, Wizard95, FluentMica, FullScreenBlue & ACME FullScreenTeal), SetupTypePreset, and MSI.DLL dialog workflow.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `LicenseRtf` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.rtf` license file displayed in Wizard 97 `LicenseAgreementDlg` and `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `IconFile` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.ico` file embedded into MSI `Icon` table (`ARPPRODUCTICON`) and `Setup.exe` resources. |
| `BannerTitle` | `string` | No | — | Optional subtitle displayed in the wizard header bar. |
| `WelcomeHeadline` | `string` | No | — | Optional custom headline on the Welcome screen. |
| `InstallButtonText` | `accel_string (must include '&')` | No | `&Install` | Accessible primary install button caption; MUST include a `&` keyboard mnemonic. |
| `FinishLaunchCheckbox` | `accel_string (must include '&')` | No | `&Launch application when setup finishes` | Accessible finish-screen launch checkbox caption; MUST include a `&` keyboard mnemonic. |
| `OfferLaunchOnFinish` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Shows the optional launch checkbox on the completion screen when `MainExecutable` is set. |
| `AllowChangeFolder` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Controls whether the destination folder box and Browse button are editable in compact / add-on setups (defaults to `false` for `PackageKind = addon`). |
| `WizardLayout` | `enum` | No | `standard` | Allowed: `standard|wizard95|wizard97|aerowizard|fluentmica|oneclick|passivetoast|fullscreenblue|fullscreenteal|autorun16x9|simple`. Selects the customer-facing `SetupWizard.exe` style: `simple` (ultra-compact single-dialog `Destination folder` + `[...]` + progress + `&Install`/`&Extract`), `standard` (RaggieSoft Glass), `wizard95` (1995 `#C0C0C0` 3D beveled + left sidebar), `wizard97` (classic top-banner), `aerowizard` (command bar + circular `<-` Back), `fluentmica` (Windows 11 Mica + left step rail), `oneclick` (compact 1-click splash), `passivetoast` (`/passive` progress), `fullscreenblue` (1995 `#000080` Cobalt wash + 3D dialog), `fullscreenteal` (1995 `#008080` Microsoft ACME Teal wash + 3D dialog), or `autorun16x9` (640x480 16:9 launcher). |
| `SetupTypePreset` | `enum` | No | `express_custom` | Allowed: `express_custom|win95_classic`. `express_custom` displays Express / Compact / Custom cards; `win95_classic` displays classic 4-option Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom cards (overridden if custom `[SetupType.<id>]` sections are defined). |
| `MsiDialogPreset` | `enum` | No | `express_custom` | Allowed: `express_custom|minimal`. `express_custom` builds the full Express / Compact / Custom + SelectionTree + BrowseDlg + Shortcuts + Repair Mode workflow inside MSI.DLL's Dialog table; `minimal` builds a compact 3-screen MSI UI. |
| `MsiProgressStyle` | `enum` | No | `standard` | Allowed: `standard|flat`. `standard` (default) sets `msidbControlAttributesProgress95` (`0x10000`) on `ProgressDlg.ProgressBar` so Windows renders a native themed Common Controls progress bar instead of MSI.DLL's legacy flat 2D box; `flat` opts into legacy owner-draw. |
| `SystemMenuAbout` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, appends an author-branded `About <ProductName> Setup...` item to the top-left `Alt+Space` window System Menu with zero forced third-party watermarks. |
| `AccentPrimaryHex` | `string` | No | `#2563EB` | Primary header/button accent hex color (checked against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in `instbuild.exe --validate`). |
| `AccentSecondaryHex` | `string` | No | `#FBBF24` | Secondary gradient accent hex color (e.g. `#FBBF24` Warm Gold, `#10B981` Emerald, `#EC4899` Rose). |
| `ArtworkPng` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.png` 16:9 banner, `164x314` wizard sidebar bitmap, or square product cover rendered inside `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `WelcomeIntro` | `string` | No | — | Optional introductory paragraph displayed on the Welcome page of `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `ReadMeText` | `string` | No | — | Optional edition liner notes or ReadMe summary displayed in the ReadMe view of `autorun16x9` installers. |
| `ExpressDescription` | `string` | No | `One-click setup into the default installation folder with recommended shortcuts. Skips extra prompts.` | Helper caption for the Express Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `CompactDescription` | `string` | No | `Installs essential core application files (`Inclusion = minimal`) with minimal disk footprint.` | Helper caption for the Compact Core Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `CustomDescription` | `string` | No | `Choose features in the MSI SelectionTree, destination folder, Start Menu group, and shortcuts step by step.` | Helper caption for the Custom Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `AuthorOrArtist` | `string` | No | — | Optional author or band credit badge displayed in `autorun16x9` book/album micro-installers. |
| `ShowComponentProgressBar` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default) in Unified Suite Setup (`PackageKind = suite`), displays a secondary `Current Component` (`0%–100%`) progress bar beneath the monotonic byte-weighted `Overall Suite Progress` (`0%–100%`) bar; Windows Taskbar `ITaskbarList3` always tracks Overall Suite Progress. |

### `[Prerequisite.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Runtime prerequisite ([Prerequisite.<id>]: .NET 11, .NET 10 LTS, WebView2, VC++ Redist, or Custom .exe/.msi) executed BEFORE msiexec with download/embedded/side-by-side delivery and reboot exit-code tracking.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Preset` | `enum` | No | `Custom` | Allowed: `Custom|DotNet11Desktop|DotNet11AspNet|DotNet11Runtime|DotNet10Desktop|DotNet10AspNet|DotNet10Runtime|DotNet9Desktop|DotNet8Desktop|EdgeWebView2|VcRedist2022`. One-click curated preset (`DotNet10Desktop`, `DotNet10AspNet`, `DotNet9Desktop`, `DotNet8Desktop`, `EdgeWebView2`, `VcRedist2022`) or `Custom`. |
| `Name` | `string` | No | — | Consumer-friendly runtime display name (auto-filled when `Preset` != `Custom`). |
| `Distribution` | `enum` | No | `download` | Allowed: `download|embedded|side-by-side`. `download` streams over WinHTTP HTTPS on demand; `embedded` packs `SourceFile` inside `Setup.exe` for offline installs; `side-by-side` reads `Redist\<FileName>` next to `Setup.exe` (with URL fallback). |
| `SourceFile` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Local runtime `.exe` or `.msi` on the build machine (required for `Distribution = embedded`, optional for `side-by-side`, supports `$(ARCH)`). |
| `FileName` | `string` | No | — | Runtime installer filename used inside `Redist\` or `%TEMP%` (auto-filled for presets). |
| `Url` | `string` | No | — | Architecture-neutral HTTPS download URL (or fallback URL for `side-by-side`). |
| `UrlX64` | `string` | No | — | Optional `x64`-specific HTTPS download URL (auto-filled for `aka.ms` presets). |
| `UrlArm64` | `string` | No | — | Optional `arm64`-specific HTTPS download URL (auto-filled for `aka.ms` presets). |
| `Sha256` | `string` | No | — | Optional expected SHA-256 hex digest verified via `bcrypt.dll` before executing a downloaded runtime. |
| `SilentArgs` | `string` | No | — | Command-line switches passed to the runtime installer (auto-filled for presets, e.g. `/install /quiet /norestart`). |
| `SuccessExitCodes` | `string` | No | `0, 1638` | Comma-separated exit codes treated as clean success (`0` = OK, `1638` = newer redistributable already installed). |
| `RebootExitCodes` | `string` | No | `3010, 1641` | Comma-separated exit codes treated as success WITH a Windows restart requested (`3010`, `1641`, `23`, or any custom vendor codes). |
| `DetectRegistryHive` | `enum` | No | `HKLM` | Allowed: `HKLM|HKCU`. Registry hive checked before running a `Custom` prerequisite (`HKLM` or `HKCU`, probed in native 64-bit view). |
| `DetectRegistryKey` | `string` | No | — | Optional registry key checked to skip an already-installed `Custom` prerequisite. |
| `DetectRegistryValue` | `string` | No | — | Optional registry value name under `DetectRegistryKey` (non-empty / non-zero means installed). |
| `DetectMinVersion` | `string` | No | — | Optional minimum dotted version compared against `DetectRegistryValue` or `DetectFilePath`. |
| `DetectFilePath` | `string` | No | — | Optional file path (supports `%ProgramW6432%` / `%SystemRoot%`) whose presence/version skips the prerequisite. |
| `DetectUpgradeCode` | `guid ({XXXXXXXX-...})` | No | — | Optional MSI `{UpgradeCode}` probed via `MsiEnumRelatedProductsW` to skip an already-installed MSI runtime. |
| `RequiresElevation` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), executes inside the single unified elevated UAC session right before `Product.msi`. |
| `Optional` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, logs a warning and continues installing `Product.msi` even if this prerequisite fails. |

### `[SuitePackage.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Child .msi or RaggieScript EXE setup package ([SuitePackage.<id>]) chained under a single UAC prompt in Unified Suite Setup (PackageKind = suite) with dynamic ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT adoption.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Consumer-facing child tool title displayed in the Unified Suite Setup & Maintenance Hub. |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Plain-English description of this child package in the Suite checklist. |
| `Delivery` | `enum` | No | `embedded` | Allowed: `embedded|side-by-side|web`. `embedded` packs the child installer inside the offline Suite `.exe`; `side-by-side` stages verified child packages in `<OutputDir>\packages\` for multi-gigabyte DVD/Boxset suites without the 2 GB PE resource limit; `web` downloads selected packages (`DownloadUrl`) via WinHTTP and verifies `Sha256` before installing. |
| `Source` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Path to the compiled child `.msi`, `-setup.exe`, or `addon` binary on the build machine (required when `Delivery = embedded`; optional when `Delivery = web` to auto-fill `Sha256` & `FileName`). |
| `DownloadUrl` | `string` | No | — | HTTPS (or `file:///`) URL for `Delivery = web` on-demand workload downloading (supports `$(ARCH)` expansion). |
| `Sha256` | `string` | No | — | Expected 64-character SHA-256 hex digest verified via `bcrypt.dll` before executing a `Delivery = web` Suite package (supports `$(ARCH)` or `Sha256X64`/`Sha256Arm64`). |
| `Sha256X64` | `string` | No | — | Optional `x64`-specific SHA-256 hex digest when `DownloadUrl` uses `$(ARCH)`. |
| `Sha256Arm64` | `string` | No | — | Optional `arm64`-specific SHA-256 hex digest when `DownloadUrl` uses `$(ARCH)`. |
| `FileName` | `string` | No | — | Optional staged filename when `Delivery = web` (defaults to the URL's filename leaf; supports `$(ARCH)`). |
| `UpgradeCode` | `guid ({XXXXXXXX-...})` | No | — | Permanent `{UpgradeCode}` of this child package used to detect & dynamically adopt already-installed standalone siblings (`RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1`). |
| `Engine` | `enum` | No | `msi` | Allowed: `msi|raggiescript|native|addon|exe`. Child installer engine (`msi` passes `RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1` via `MsiInstallProductW`; `raggiescript` / `native` / `addon` / `exe` passes `/s RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1`). |
| `InstallArgs` | `string` | No | — | Optional extra properties or CLI switches passed to this child package during Suite install. |
| `Required` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, locks this core Suite package as required in the Suite Setup checklist. |
| `SelectedByDefault` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Whether this child package is pre-checked by default on fresh Suite installations. |
| `Inclusion` | `enum` | No | `typical` | Allowed: `minimal|typical|complete`. Controls which Suite Setup Type presets automatically select this package: `minimal` (included in Compact/Minimal, Express/Typical, & Complete), `typical` (included in Express/Typical & Complete), or `complete` (included in Complete or when checked in Custom Setup). `Required = true` always implies `minimal`. |
| `AdoptStandalone` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), dynamically adopts any already-installed standalone sibling (`REINSTALL=ALL REINSTALLMODE=vomus RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1`) under the single Suite Installed Apps entry. |
| `RollbackBoundary` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true` under `SuiteRollbackPolicy = rollback_new`, commits all packages up through this item as a savepoint so a later failure does not uninstall earlier foundational prerequisites/tools. |
| `ForwardInstallDir` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, passes `SUITE_INSTALLDIR="<SuiteDir>"` into this child package so member apps or add-ons align under a shared Suite root. |
| `Category` | `string` | No | `Suite` | Optional category badge displayed for this application in the Unified Suite Setup checklist. |
| `Version` | `string` | No | — | Optional display version (`X.Y.Z`) shown alongside this child package in the Suite checklist. |
| `EstimatedSizeKB` | `integer` | No | `0` | Optional uncompressed size override in kilobytes used to weight Overall Suite Progress (`0` uses actual payload size). |

### `[Feature.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Named Feature or Sub-Feature ([Feature.<id>]) with plain-English Inclusion tiers, optional Run-from-Source (MenuCD/MenuNetwork), and embedded vs. external .rswpak on-demand delivery.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Title` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Consumer-facing title of this MSI Feature. |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Plain-English description of this MSI Feature shown in SelectionTree. |
| `Level` | `integer` | No | `1` | MSI InstallLevel (`1` = core/Compact & Express, `2..100` = Express/Custom optional, `0` = hidden). |
| `Inclusion` | `enum` | No | `minimal` | Allowed: `minimal|typical|complete|hidden`. Plain-English setup inclusion tier replacing raw numeric `InstallLevel`: `minimal` (`Level = 1`, installed in Minimal/Compact, Typical/Express, & Complete), `typical` (`Level = 50`, installed in Typical/Express & Complete, skipped in Minimal/Compact), `complete` (`Level = 150`, installed in Complete or when opted in inside Custom SelectionTree), or `hidden` (`Level = 0`, hidden/conditional). |
| `Parent` | `string` | No | — | Optional parent Feature ID (`Feature_Parent`) creating a hierarchical sub-feature in `SelectionTree`. |
| `DisallowAbsent` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbFeatureAttributesUIDisallowAbsent` (`16`) locking a required core feature so users cannot disable it in `SelectionTree`. |
| `AllowAdvertise` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `false` (default), sets `msidbFeatureAttributesDisallowAdvertise` (`8`) hiding MSI on-demand advertisement; set `true` to enable 'Feature will be installed when required'. |
| `AllowRunFromSource` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, sets `msidbComponentAttributesOptional` (`2`) on owned components and enables `MenuCD` ('Will be installed to run from CD') & `MenuNetwork` ('Will be installed to run from network') in `SelectionTree`. |
| `Delivery` | `enum` | No | `embedded` | Allowed: `embedded|ondemand`. `embedded` packs feature files inside the main installer; `ondemand` splits this feature into an external LZMS-compressed `<OutputName>-<FeatureId>.rswpak` block fetched via WinHTTP with SHA-256 + Authenticode verification when selected. |
| `PackUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional HTTPS download URL for `<OutputName>-<FeatureId>.rswpak` when `Delivery = ondemand` (defaults to `UniversalDownloadBaseUrl` or side-by-side local `.rswpak`). |

### `[Component.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Explicit MSI Component ([Component.<id>]) enforcing Microsoft Single-Directory & KeyPath rules (File, Registry, or CreateFolder).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this Component in `FeatureComponents`. |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. Single Windows Installer root directory for this Component (Microsoft Single-Directory Component Rule). |
| `TargetSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional subdirectory under `TargetRoot` where all files of this Component reside. |
| `Guid` | `guid_or_auto ('*' or {GUID})` | No | `*` | `*` computes a deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 ComponentId, or specify an explicit `{GUID}`. |
| `KeyPathKind` | `enum` | No | `auto` | Allowed: `auto|file|registry|folder`. KeyPath resource type required by Windows Installer (`file` = File table key, `registry` = Registry key per ICE38, `folder` = NULL KeyPath + CreateFolder per ICE18). |
| `KeyPathTarget` | `string` | No | — | Target filename (when `KeyPathKind = file`) or `[Registry.<id>]` section ID (when `KeyPathKind = registry`). |
| `Condition` | `string` | No | — | Optional MSI install condition evaluated during `CostFinalize` (e.g. `DESKTOP_SHORTCUT = "1"`). |
| `Permanent` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesPermanent` (`16`) so Windows Installer leaves this component on disk during uninstall. |
| `NeverOverwrite` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesNeverOverwrite` (`128`) so existing user-modified config files/keys are never overwritten. |
| `SharedDllRefCount` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesSharedDllRefCount` (`8`) for legacy shared reference counting. |

### `[Payload.<id>]` (*Required*)

| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning the generated file component(s). |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. | `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this file association. |

### `[Environment.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Configures a user or system Environment Variable ([Environment.<id>]), including non-clobbering PATH append/prepend with exact uninstall removal across MSI & RaggieScript EXE.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | `PATH` | Environment variable name (e.g. `PATH` or `RAGGIESOFT_STUDIO_HOME`). |
| `Value` | `string` | **Yes** | `[INSTALLDIR]` | Formatted value or directory path to set/append (e.g. `[INSTALLDIR]` or `[INSTALLDIR]bin`). |
| `Action` | `enum` | No | `append_path` | Allowed: `append_path|prepend_path|set|create_if_absent`. `append_path` (`[~];Value`) appends safely without clobbering existing entries and removes only its own entry on uninstall; `prepend_path` (`Value;[~]`) prepends; `set` overwrites; `create_if_absent` (`+Name`) sets only if unset. |
| `Scope` | `enum` | No | `auto` | Allowed: `auto|machine|user`. `auto` matches `[Package] Scope`, `machine` writes to System (`*Name`), and `user` writes to `HKCU\Environment`. |
| `RemoveOnUninstall` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true` (default), removes this variable or `PATH` segment cleanly on uninstallation (`=-Name`). |
| `OnUninstall` | `enum` | No | `remove` | Allowed: `remove|keep`. Alias for `RemoveOnUninstall` (`remove` removes this variable or `PATH` segment on uninstallation; `keep` leaves it intact). |
| `Condition` | `string` | No | — | Optional MSI component condition (e.g. `ADD_TO_PATH = "1"` bound to a custom wizard checkbox!). |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this environment variable rule. |
| `Component` | `string` | No | — | Optional explicit `[Component.<id>]` name. |

### `[IniFile.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Writes or updates a [Section] Key = Value entry inside a target .ini configuration file ([IniFile.<id>]) across MSI & RaggieScript EXE.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `FileName` | `string` | **Yes** | `settings.ini` | Target `.ini` filename inside `TargetRoot` / `TargetSubdir`. |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. Destination root folder containing `FileName` (`INSTALLDIR`, `AppDataFolder`, `LocalAppDataFolder`, `CommonAppDataFolder`, etc.). |
| `TargetSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional subfolder inside `TargetRoot`. |
| `Section` | `string` | **Yes** | `General` | INI `[Section]` header name. |
| `Key` | `string` | **Yes** | — | INI key name within `[Section]`. |
| `Value` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Formatted INI value (supports `[INSTALLDIR]`, `[ProductVersion]`, and custom dialog properties). |
| `Action` | `enum` | No | `add_line` | Allowed: `add_line|set|create_line|create_only|add_tag|remove_key`. `add_line` / `set` (`0` = create or update key), `create_line` / `create_only` (`1` = write only if key does not exist), `add_tag` (`3` = append comma-separated tag), or `remove_key`. |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this INI rule. |
| `Component` | `string` | No | — | Optional explicit `[Component.<id>]` name. |

### `[Dialog.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Defines a custom C++ SetupWizard.exe page ([Dialog.<id>]) edited in the WYSIWYG Visual Dialog Designer and spliced into the runtime setup flow.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Title` | `string` | **Yes** | `Custom Configuration` | Heading displayed on this custom `SetupWizard.exe` page. |
| `Subtitle` | `string` | No | — | Supporting subtitle displayed beneath `Title`. |
| `AfterPage` | `enum` | No | `SetupType` | Allowed: `Welcome|License|SetupType|CustomFeatures|CustomFolder|CustomShortcuts`. Wizard step after which this custom page appears in `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `ShowInModes` | `enum` | No | `all` | Allowed: `all|custom_only`. `all` displays this page in Express & Custom flows; `custom_only` displays it only when Custom Setup is selected. |

### `[Control.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Places a Per-Monitor V2 DPI Win32 control ([Control.<id>]: Label, Edit, PathEdit, CheckBox, RadioGroup, ComboBox, GroupBox) onto a custom C++ [Dialog.<id>] page.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Dialog` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Target `[Dialog.<id>]` page owning this control. |
| `Type` | `enum` | **Yes** | `CheckBox` | Allowed: `Text|Label|Heading|Edit|PasswordEdit|PathEdit|CheckBox|RadioGroup|RadioButtonGroup|ComboBox|ListBox|GroupBox|Line`. Control widget kind rendered in `SetupWizard.exe` and the IDE Visual Dialog Designer. |
| `X` | `integer` | No | `24` | Horizontal position in 96-DPI logical pixels inside the wizard content area (`0..560`). |
| `Y` | `integer` | No | `20` | Vertical position in 96-DPI logical pixels inside the wizard content area (`0..240`). |
| `Width` | `integer` | No | `500` | Control width in 96-DPI logical pixels. |
| `Height` | `integer` | No | `26` | Control height in 96-DPI logical pixels. |
| `Property` | `string` | No | — | Uppercase MSI / Native property bound two-way to this control (automatically added to `SecureCustomProperties`!). |
| `DefaultValue` | `string` | No | — | Initial value assigned to `Property` before the dialog opens. |
| `Text` | `string` | No | — | Control caption or prompt (include a `&` keyboard mnemonic on interactive inputs/checkboxes!). |
| `Items` | `string` | No | — | Pipe-separated `Value:Caption` options for `RadioGroup`, `RadioButtonGroup`, `ComboBox`, or `ListBox` controls. |
| `TabOrder` | `integer` | No | `0` | Explicit keyboard `Tab` focus sequence order (`0` = document order). |
| `Required` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | When `true`, blocks `&Next >` on this custom page until the user supplies a non-empty value. |

### `[MsiDialog.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Defines a custom 370x270 Windows Installer SQL Dialog ([MsiDialog.<id>]) spliced into the MSI.DLL UI sequence.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Title` | `string` | No | `[ProductName] Setup` | Window caption bar title of this MSI Dialog. |
| `Width` | `integer` | No | `370` | Width in Windows Installer dialog units (standard Wizard 97 width is `370`). |
| `Height` | `integer` | No | `270` | Height in Windows Installer dialog units (standard Wizard 97 height is `270`). |
| `Banner` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Automatically adds standard Wizard 97 top `BannerBitmap`, `BannerLine`, `BottomLine`, and `Back`/`Next`/`Cancel` buttons. |
| `HeaderTitle` | `string` | No | `Custom Configuration` | Bold title text rendered inside the top 44-unit Wizard 97 banner. |
| `HeaderSubtitle` | `string` | No | — | Subtitle description rendered beneath `HeaderTitle` inside the top Wizard 97 banner. |
| `PrevDialog` | `string` | No | `SetupTypeDlg` | Previous dialog ID in the wizard chain (`< &Back` target and automatic forward splice point!). |
| `NextDialog` | `string` | No | `VerifyReadyDlg` | Next dialog ID opened when the user clicks `&Next >`. |

### `[MsiControl.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Adds a native MSI control ([MsiControl.<id>]: Text, Edit, CheckBox, RadioButtonGroup, etc.) to a new or built-in MSI Dialog.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Dialog` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Target dialog ID (`[MsiDialog.<Dialog>]` or built-in dialog such as `SetupTypeDlg` or `VerifyReadyDlg`). |
| `Type` | `enum` | **Yes** | `Text` | Allowed: `Text|Edit|MaskedEdit|PathEdit|CheckBox|RadioButtonGroup|PushButton|ComboBox|ListBox|SelectionTree|GroupBox|Line|Bitmap|ScrollableText`. Native Windows Installer Control table type. |
| `X` | `integer` | **Yes** | `20` | Horizontal position in MSI dialog units (`0..370`). |
| `Y` | `integer` | **Yes** | `60` | Vertical position in MSI dialog units (`0..270`). |
| `Width` | `integer` | **Yes** | `330` | Control width in MSI dialog units. |
| `Height` | `integer` | **Yes** | `18` | Control height in MSI dialog units. |
| `Property` | `string` | No | — | MSI Property bound to this control (automatically added to `SecureCustomProperties` if uppercase!). |
| `DefaultValue` | `string` | No | — | Optional initial value written to the MSI `Property` table. |
| `Text` | `string` | No | — | Control label or rich text (`{\DlgFontBold8}...`). |
| `Items` | `string` | No | — | Pipe-separated `Value:Caption` entries for `RadioButtonGroup`, `ComboBox`, or `ListBox` controls. |

## 3. `.rsis` Multi-Project Suite Schema (Optional — Multi-Package Workspace)

```ini
[Suite]
Name          = Sample Studio Workspace
Version       = 1.0.0
Architectures = arm64|x64

[Variable]
PUBLISHER     = Sample Studio

[Project.CoreMsm]
Path          = shared\core-runtime.rsip
Category      = MergeModules
BuildOrder    = 10

[Project.DesktopApp]
Path          = apps\desktop-client.rsip
Category      = CoreApps
BuildOrder    = 20
```

## 4. Minimal From-Scratch `.rsip` Project Blueprint

```ini
; Minimal standalone RaggieSoft Installer Project (.rsip) — compiles x64 and arm64!
[Package]
Name              = Hello Studio App
Tagline           = Fast, Accessible Native Windows Application
Version           = 1.0.0
Manufacturer      = Sample Studio
UpgradeCode       = {A18F4E20-7C93-4D62-9B44-524147474945}
Architecture      = $(ARCH)
Scope             = machine
BuildBootstrapper = true

[Install]
DefaultSubdir     = Sample Studio\Hello App
MainExecutable    = HelloApp.exe

[UI]
WizardLayout      = aerowizard
AccentPrimaryHex  = #2563EB
AccentSecondaryHex= #FBBF24
InstallButtonText = &Install

[Payload.App]
Source            = ..\..\bin\$(ARCH)\HelloApp.exe

[Shortcut.StartMenu]
Name              = Hello Studio App
TargetFile        = HelloApp.exe
Location          = StartMenu
Description       = Launch Hello Studio App
```

## 5. Complete Enterprise `.rsip` Blueprint (SelectionTree Features, Pre-MSI Runtimes, `.MSM`, FileAssoc & Custom MSI Dialog)

```ini
; Full-featured enterprise .rsip demonstrating SelectionTree hierarchy, Pre-MSI
; Prerequisites, 64-bit .MSM Merge Modules, File Associations, & Custom MSI SQL Dialogs.
[Package]
Name              = Studio Workbench
Tagline           = Accessible Desktop Authoring Environment
WebsiteLabel      = raggiesoftstudio.com
Version           = 2.1.0
Manufacturer      = RaggieSoft
UpgradeCode       = {7F4E91C2-58B4-4D21-8E77-314159265358}
Architecture      = $(ARCH)
Scope             = machine
OutputName        = studio-workbench-$(ARCH)
OutputDir         = out
BuildBootstrapper = true

[Requirements]
MinWindowsBuild   = 22000

[Install]
DefaultSubdir     = RaggieSoft\Studio Workbench
StartMenuFolder   = RaggieSoft Studio Workbench
MainExecutable    = Workbench.exe

[UI]
WizardLayout          = aerowizard
MsiDialogPreset       = express_custom
AccentPrimaryHex      = #2563EB
AccentSecondaryHex    = #FBBF24
LicenseRtf            = License.rtf
InstallButtonText     = &Install
FinishLaunchCheckbox  = &Launch Studio Workbench when setup finishes

; Hierarchical MSI SelectionTree Features (Core locked via DisallowAbsent = true)
[Feature.Main]
Title                 = Core Workbench Application
Description           = Primary executable and core authoring engine.
Level                 = 1
DisallowAbsent        = true

[Feature.Templates]
Parent                = Main
Title                 = Starter Project Templates
Description           = Optional starter blueprints and offline documentation.
Level                 = 1

; Pre-MSI Runtime Prerequisite (runs BEFORE msiexec under one UAC prompt)
[Prerequisite.DotNet10]
Preset                = DotNet10Desktop
Distribution          = download
RebootExitCodes       = 3010, 1641, 23

; Optional 64-Bit Merge Module (.msm) merged natively into Product.msi
[MergeModule.SharedCodec]
Source                = ..\shared\out\shared-codec-$(ARCH).msm
Feature               = Main
TargetRoot            = INSTALLDIR

[Component.CoreExeComp]
Feature               = Main
TargetRoot            = INSTALLDIR
Guid                  = *
KeyPathKind           = file
KeyPathTarget         = Workbench.exe

[Payload.MainExe]
Source                = ..\bin\$(ARCH)\Workbench.exe
Component             = CoreExeComp

[Payload.TemplatesDir]
Source                = ..\templates
TargetRoot            = INSTALLDIR
TargetSubdir          = templates
Feature               = Templates

[FileAssociation.WorkbenchDoc]
Extension             = .rswb
ProgId                = RaggieSoft.Workbench.Document
Description           = Studio Workbench Project
TargetFile            = Workbench.exe
Verbs                 = open:&Open in Workbench:"%1"
Advertise             = false

[Shortcut.StartMenuApp]
Name                  = Studio Workbench
TargetFile            = Workbench.exe
Location              = StartMenu

[MsiDialog.WorkspaceUrlDlg]
HeaderTitle           = Default Asset Endpoint
PrevDialog            = SetupTypeDlg
NextDialog            = VerifyReadyDlg

[MsiControl.EndpointEdit]
Dialog                = WorkspaceUrlDlg
Type                  = Edit
X                     = 20
Y                     = 74
Width                 = 330
Height                = 18
Property              = ASSET_ENDPOINT
DefaultValue          = https://assets.raggiesoft.com
```
